prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 LEVEL SELECTION page for a Chinese papercraft co-op game about JIAOZI paper currency and a fictional Song-dynasty world.
USER'S LATEST PRIORITY: Design a NEW map and NEW buildings related to Jiaozi, Song architecture and Song cultural elements. DO NOT recreate an existing project map, old papermaking courtyard layout, game station arrangement or an old level scene. The attached map reference is only the immersive TABLETOP POP-UP MAP FORM.
INPUTS: Image1 PRIMARY composition reference: an unfolded paper map on an artisan desk, standing folded-paper buildings, vertical place tags, path and foreground booklet; match this immersive object-based world-map format, not flat cards. Image2 ONLY style continuity: airy rice-paper, restrained mineral sage/blue-grey, small vermilion/ochre accents, expressive ink lettering and tidy stamped symbols. Do NOT copy its folding-screen layout, animal figures or character selection states.
ART DIRECTION: A beautifully handmade Song-inspired commercial town emerging from a huge illustrated paper-currency scroll on a wooden desk. The scroll map is one continuous wide sheet with crisp folded terrain, lightly curled edges and quiet Jiaozi-inspired woodblock border patterns and square-holed coin motifs at its margin. Soft bright daylight, ample visual breathing room, fresh harmonious color, not a dark sepia tavern. Fine natural paper grain, lightly painted gouache and uneven elegant ink outlines. Visible paper thickness on folds and construction tabs, NOT leathery embossed noise or shiny 3D plastic.
COMPOSITION: oblique view down about35degrees. The unfolded scroll fills nearly all center and foreground, desk appears at top and corners, a quiet brush/inkstone/wood seal/rolled paper in background. A river of painted mineral blue curves through the map, crossed by one delicate folded-paper wooden bridge. Along its bank stand new Song-inspired timber-framed commercial buildings with grey-blue tiled eaves, modest brackets, layered low roofs, open shop fronts, hanging cloth shop banners and bamboo blinds. Buildings are stylized shallow paper constructions, not exact historical reconstructions. Sparse old-gold ginkgo cut-outs and small sage trees, not dense forest. A tiny unloaded paper boat near the bank. No people.
ONE main prominent selectable destination at center-left x38%, y46%, taking ~35%width: a charming two-storey Jiaozi printing/exchange SHOP COMPLEX with clear central entrance, joined low side shops, wood lattice windows, blue-grey tiled roofs, a counter with a short stack of banknote sheets, a thin inked printing slab and a small vermilion seal. Treat it as a NEW architectural landmark, not a copied gameplay courtyard, and not a palace. The tiny note decoration shows borders, coin symbols and abstract columns only, no human portraits. A slim vertical cream-paper sign beside it reads "开张第一单", with a little red "01" stamp at top. A subtle dry-ink vermilion circular map marker beneath this main building signifies selected.
Other structures (a small distant town gateway at upper-right, two low waterside shop roof silhouettes in the middle distance) are quiet unlabelled scenery 40% or less of main node size, without tags, numbers, locks, glowing circles or controls. EXACTLY ONE formal playable level node in this scope. Do not turn printing/papermaking/stamping into separate levels, do not invent a second level title or Boss node.
A winding illustrated ink/ochre path runs from foreground bridge to the main shop door. Spare road recedes into pale paper-mist near the curled far end without announcing more levels. Foreground lower-left has a small open ledger with a red fabric bookmark and a few simple woodblock note borders, plus one square-holed coin, integrated as beautiful physical desk objects without writing or interactive labels. Vary scale and layered paper elevations to give the map the rich pop-up quality of reference1.
UI IS VERY SPARSE and embedded in objects:
Top-left small back arrow and "返回", then brush title "选择关卡". No large game logo or header frame.
Top-right tiny P1 jade circular stamp and P2 vermilion diamond stamp, next to short "双人合作". No pre-chosen characters or animal portraits.
Lower-right the natural curled-up blank corner of map leaves space for small line "双人 · 180秒" and ONE slim elegant parchment button "选择搭档". This navigates to two-player character selection before gameplay. No detached right sidebar, no description card, no paragraph, no full-width bottom bar. No other selection buttons.
Typography: crisp readable Chinese brush destination label and page title, fine restrained ink text for short utility labels, dull ochre single-line control edge.
TEXT WHITELIST ONLY: "返回", "选择关卡", "开张第一单", "01", "P1", "P2", "双人合作", "双人 · 180秒", "选择搭档". Keep all other cloth shop banners and paper documents pictorial/no text. Do not copy reference event title, city names, human-shaped red marker, resource/energy counters, shop/reward/daily tasks, challenge gate, stars or badges. No human characters, no visible fixed animal players, no human-portrait notes, no watermark or screenshot overlays.
Overall impression: a refined, inviting miniature Song paper-town on a currency-scroll map, newly composed for the game. Buildings, river, folds and Jiaozi artifacts carry the scene; UI text is minimal. Full-page landscape16:9.
